## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 159 captures during April 2020. This report summarises activity for the month, with the capture total providing the overall measure of imaging completed at the site. The activity figure is presented alongside the image-quality and grading results below to support routine monitoring of service performance.

## Image quality

Of the 159 captures, 6 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.8. This result identifies the number of images that could not proceed through grading and records the associated rate for the reporting period. Image-quality information is reported separately so that it can be reviewed alongside the grading outcome.

## Grading

Grading identified 29 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 days. Together, the referable total and median lag provide the main grading measures for April 2020 at West Gate Eye Clinic. These figures should be considered with the capture volume and ungradable results when reviewing the site’s monthly operations.
